implementation_difference: N3: normalized contrast per channel, then multiplicative feature gating; no ON/OFF residual paths.
hypothesis_and_control: Contrast should improve referral beyond generic attention; test subtraction and a recurrent attention-budget control.
observed_evidence: N2 minus no-subtraction: +0.43 pp. N3 minus budget generic: −0.57 pp [−2.43, 1.14]; AUROC +0.0018 [−0.0011, 0.0049].
attribution_limit_and_next_test: Recurrent support/nonlinearity differ. P1 conditional: compare stage and representation; redundancy unproven.

implementation_difference: Finite Gaussian supports; bounded scale multipliers shared across channels per modality.
hypothesis_and_control: Scale diversity should improve referral; repeat one scale, vary σ and insertion stride.
observed_evidence: N2 three scales minus repeated scale: +0.86 pp. N2 stride-4/8/16: 80.97/80.26/80.83%, all below M0R. No lesion-scale measurements.
attribution_limit_and_next_test: Depth changes semantics and support. P2 future test: measure training-only lesion sizes and match support.

implementation_difference: Feature-variance denominator with bounded ρ/ε, trained for classification rather than spike responses.
hypothesis_and_control: Adaptive gain should add referral value; frozen interventions, retraining and jointly fixed N3 coefficients.
observed_evidence: N2 minus global-only/raw: +0.14/+0.29 pp. N3 minus fixed: −0.14 pp [−1.86, 1.57]; AUROC +0.0013.
attribution_limit_and_next_test: Joint fixing does not isolate coefficients. P3 conditional: distinguish fitted-model sensitivity from learning.

implementation_difference: Static signed rectification; channel-specific scale mixers instead of separate cellular populations.
hypothesis_and_control: Signed responses should outperform sign-invariant bases at the same attention budget.
attribution_limit_and_next_test: Magnitude and magnitude² alter nonlinear statistics. P4 hypothesis; temporal physiology untested.

implementation_difference: Keep normalized channel responses; late-pooling control averages after filtering and broadcasts back.
hypothesis_and_control: Channel retention should improve referral independently of filtering cost.
attribution_limit_and_next_test: Statistics and mixing change together. P4 hypothesis; P5 conditional: assess ranking and the joint decision rule.
